title: Quote record
description: One derived export record per extracted quote. PostgreSQL is the system of record when persistence is enabled; JSONL is derived from the same verified records and is rebuilt from Postgres only with --from-db. Verbatim quote text must be an exact substring of the article webpage.

quote_id.description: Deterministic ID: Q-YYYYMMDD-NNNN, where the date is the publication date and NNNN is a sequence within that day.

quote_text_original.description: Verbatim quote text exactly as published, including original punctuation and typography. No cleanup beyond removing page furniture that is not part of the quote.

quote_html.description: Optional original HTML fragment of the quote, preserving emphasis and formatting structure.

quote_text_en.description: Additional English translation when generated or supplied. Never replaces quote_text_original.

speaker.description: Attributed speaker of the quote as published; empty string when absent.

topic_id.description: Topic pack identifier from data/topics/<topic_id>.json; legacy exports default to ukraine-war.

topic_status.description: Article-level topic-gate outcome that admitted this quote. Legacy exports default to accepted.

topic_rule_version.description: Pinned version of the deterministic relevance rule used for the topic decision.

topic_score.description: Score assigned by the topic rule; provenance only, never a publication threshold on its own.

matched_terms.description: Terms that matched the topic rule, recorded for auditability.

source_id.description: Foreign key to source_id in sources.csv.

publication_name.description: Optional publication/imprint name when it differs from source_name.

rights_status.description: T0 gate snapshot. Only license_held or api_permitted allow a source to be enabled and ingested.

access_mode.description: Approved route for retrieving content. Feeds are not an exemption from the rights check.

license_reference.description: Licence or consent ID proving T0 approval; empty until approved.

claim_only.description: If true, the quote may be shown only as an attributed claim or perspective, never as an established fact in the daily report.

original_reporting_flag.description: Result of the per-article original-reporting check from section 1.1 of the spec.

source_language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the article language.

quote_language.description: Detected ISO 639-1 code of the quote itself, or ISO 639-3 'und' when undetermined; may differ from source_language.

translation_hash.description: SHA-256 of inputs and output for the translation decision.

translation_status.description: Outcome of the optional translation step.

article_author.description: Byline as published; empty string if absent.

article_url.description: Stable canonical URL of the source article.

extraction_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC when the quote was extracted.

section_id.description: Foreign key to section_id in sections.csv or the active topic pack.

is_obsolete.description: True when the factual content of the quote has been superseded by newer known facts; such quotes are excluded from the daily report.

obsolete_reason.description: Required in practice when is_obsolete is true: which later fact supersedes this quote.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over [source_id, canonical_url, quote_text_original, char_start (as text), raw_blob_sha256] in that order; used for deterministic deduplication and tamper checks.

verbatim_match.description: True only if the stored quote text is an exact substring of the fetched article.

metadata_verified.description: True only if source, date, title, author and URL were read from the page itself.

method.description: Deterministic verification method, for example sha256_substring_match_v1.

notes.description: Audit notes, for example a correction or a reason a record was re-issued.
